description: 기상청_태풍정보 조회서비스 [typhoons, cyclones and storms] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 기상청. 태풍은 바다로부터 증발한 수증기를 공급받아 강도를 유지하면서 고위도로 이동하게 됩니다. 이러한 과정을 통해 태풍은 지구 남북 간의 에너지 불균형을 해소하는 역할을 합니다. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source.
